source: Supabase gateway edge_logs of the canonical DEV project, read-only query 2026-09-30 after the run; requests to /rest/v1/rpc/rpc_discovery_v1 between 19:01:00Z and 19:07:00Z (device clock = UTC+2). Only time, request size, status and upstream time are kept.
note: Request size is how earlier rounds told the modes apart (85 bytes = EXACT_PUBLIC, 189 = first PAGE, 377-438 = MAP/PAGE with bounds). The phone ran only this measurement in the window.

phases.phase: cold start attempt 1 (install killed the app, the script stopped at its foreground guard)
cold start attempt 2 (--restart): first page, two MAP reads, MAP over the viewport
the script's list read and map zoom (before the pins)
five pin touches: one EXACT_PUBLIC read each (the card was already on screen from the loaded row; the read confirms)
after the pins, before the Back cycles: map read, list read (the script's own reset)
four Back cycles 19:04:55 to 19:06:00 (device trace: four warm returns)

result: No rpc_discovery_v1 request of any mode during the four Back returns; BEFORE, every return read the first page and the map.
